label: Private Grumbling
notes: Only visible as sharper dialogue. No mechanical penalty yet.

label: Formal Petition
notes: Explicit demand delivered in council. This is your clearest warning.

label: Open Obstruction
notes: Orders start failing. Players who ignore stage 2 land here.

label: Conspiracy
notes: Hidden without a Spymaster. This is where a bad appointment kills you.

label: Open Revolt
notes: Rebel armies spawn from defecting provinces. Full civil war.

label: Deposition
notes: Terminal. Player either wins the battle or the campaign ends.
